title: Surreal Swamp Stasis
description: A surreal swamp scene at dusk features two figures dueling with glowing purple lightsabers on a wooden dock and in a hammock, one a skeleton in a hat serving food. Massive twisted trees draped in moss dominate the frame, with floating red and blue dominoes dripping liquid, a green cat-like creature, and a city skyline visible behind a red bridge.
prompt: Surreal swamp scene at twilight with massive twisted trees covered in Spanish moss, a skeleton in a hat and blue cap standing in a glowing green hammock holding food trays while dueling with purple lightsabers against a man in a black jacket on a wooden dock labeled STASIS, floating red and blue dominoes dripping liquid from the sky, a green cat-like creature leaping from a tree, colorful masks hanging from branches, city skyline and red bridge in the background, highly detailed, surreal atmosphere
